aboutText: With over 20 years of experience, MTG Electrotech Contracting has been the trusted electrical and data professional for Hoppers Crossing and Melbourne's west. We back every job with a 12-month workmanship warranty and use only reputable brands with full manufacturers' warranties. Our commitment to safety and quality means any defect is treated as a priority and fixed at no extra cost to you.
